framings.label: Neutral wire report of US offer
framings.description: Reports the claim in near-identical headlines as attributed news: Zelensky says the US floated or asked about Ukraine ceding or withdrawing from Donbas in exchange for NATO membership.

framings.label: Zelensky resisting, plan benefits Putin
framings.description: Presents the proposal through Zelensky's pushback, stressing that he stands firm on Donbas, that Ukraine must decide, and that the US plan or security framework could benefit Putin.

framings.label: Legal and explanatory analysis
framings.description: Treats the idea as a question to unpack, asking whether Ukraine can lawfully trade territory and what the deal would mean for Ukraine, Russia and Zelensky, or comparing coverage across outlets.

framings.label: Part of wider negotiation dynamics
framings.description: Places the proposal within ongoing US-Russia-Ukraine talks, alongside Putin signaling no compromise, Russia seeking to revise European security, and Trump blaming personal hatred between leaders.

framings.label: Bundled with Starshield pressure claims
framings.description: Pairs the Donbas-for-NATO claim with Zelensky's accusations that SpaceX is restricting Starshield or Starlink access during talks, which SpaceX denies, so the offer appears alongside concerns about leverage over Ukraine.
